claims.claim: v0.12 get_free_page invokes swap_out when no free page is found; no swapd daemon is involved in this path.
v0.12 swap_out scans page-table entries and try_to_swap_out distinguishes dirty pages from clean pages; the code does not implement a second-chance CLOCK policy.
v0.95a has file_operations and inode_operations; v0.96c fs/super.c contains file_systems[] and get_fs_type().
The 0.96c release announcement calls extended filesystem support alpha and states it supported long filenames and partitions greater than 64MB while mkefs was not yet available.
The v0.98-pl1 README says TCP/IP sources were present but not compiled into the normal binary; SCSI, extfs, dosfs and proc-fs were present with testing caveats.
claims.locator: Things you may want to get rid of; TCP/IP code

claims.claim: v0.99-pl11 uses task TSS CR3 and preserves page-directory entries 768..1023 while clearing user entries 0..767.
The v1.0 tag is dated 1994-03-14 and its announcement says there were no new major features compared with pl15, mainly bug fixes.
